harness.caveat: finish() records harness_sha256 when a run ends, not when it starts. The harness file was edited several times while the baseline runs were in progress (whole-root digest, baseline default, supplement mode, extra sweep steps); each running Python process keeps the revision it loaded at start. retained-B1 started on the earliest revision, before the whole-root digest and baseline-default edits, so result-retained-B1.json carries no harness_sha256 or final_root_tree_sha256; its replay path is the same code as in later revisions. retained-B2 and later runs record the hash of the file as it stood when they finished. Committed revisions are the two hashes above; no uncommitted edit is expected to be live once the last queued run starts (the file is frozen after commit f1da6f1e7).
